statute.name: New York Freedom of Information Law

response.rule_text: Acknowledgment within 5 business days; a date for the full response must be given. Exact clocks not verified.

fees.copy_rule: 25 cents per photocopy up to 9 by 14 inches.

appeal.body: Committee on Open Government (advisory only); Article 78 in state Supreme Court
appeal.rule_text: Administrative appeal within 30 days to the body's appeals officer, decided in 10 business days; then Article 78 proceeding. COOG opinions are not binding.
